prediction_text: The sick doctor's disease is in the breast and stomach, a cold melancholic (Saturnine) humour oppressing the breast/stomach — heaviness and obstruction there, not a hot fever. It is curable: he will recover, but slowly, the disease being fixed and lingering rather than acute. (Here 'positive' = curable/recovery.)
timing: Month scale (fixed angles and fixed signs make it lingering): recovery gradual over weeks to a few months, not days; no single crisis day is given by the testimonies.
basis: Lilly sickness rules (Christian Astrology Bk II): the 6th house afflicted by a planet in his fall placed therein shows the disease and its weakness of cause; Saturn in Cancer — Cancer signifies the breast and stomach, Saturn a cold, melancholic humour — fixes the afflicted part and quality. The lord of the Ascendant has lately separated from a dexter square of Saturn: the worst of the Saturnine oppression is past, a recovery testimony. The Moon in the 4th with Saturn and all angles fixed make it obstinate and slow (hence low confidence on speed), but no lord-of-the-8th affliction of the Ascendant is testified, so death is not judged.
